ratings.comment: Very easy on the eyes and pleasant to listen to. I enjoyed the books we read for the class, I enjoyed the lecture, just wish the TA had been as good as the professor because discussion section was awful. If you don't like taking tests, this is the class for you. Grades were based on two essays, one for the midterm and one for the final
great class. enjoy! I'm looking to take another class with this professor next semester

I took Cook's Romantic poetry class. As it was my first poetry class I found it difficult to grasp the technical stuff but the professor made it soooo much clearer. Mainly because he's the most patient teacher in the world ever!!! Highly recommend!!!!!!!

Awesome!!! Cook is the best professor I have had at UW. He's smart and really knows his material. Lectures are extremely informative and yet still entertaining: he goes at a good pace, varying it at he goes to keep you on your toes. I loved the books we read. Like the person above I also found my TA arrogant (she is young). Prof Cook is THE best!!

Cook was a good lecturer, and he was British! This class was very easy.  We only read four books and a selection of poems.  No tests, just 3 papers. Lectures were not necessary but he would walk through the texts pointing out themes and symbols.  He was very funny at times as well.

Awesome class. The lectures are always interesting and lively, and the sectionals always generate good debate. I enjoyed reading most of the texts but the Joyce novel takes extra effort. The professor always has time for questions. Strongly recommend!!!!

Loved this class. Readings are difficult to keep up with but Cook walks you through the text and important ideas.  Not necessary to go to lecture, but he has a great sense of humor and is easy on the eyes:)

Love love love this class. I found the reading difficult to keep on top of at first, but you soon get into your stride. the professor does a good job of guiding you through the complex ideas and problems, but I found my ta arrogant. You'll love the lectures! they are REALLY useful. I've just enrolled in his next class too!!!

This is a GREAT class! The novels are hard but well worth the effort you put in. Professor Cook's lectures really help put them into perspective. He is a *VERY* intelligent guy who really knows his stuff. And his lectures are really entertaining -- even lol funny at times! The Professor is very approachable. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS CLASS!!

Great lecturer. British! English 175 is a very easy class. Just do the reading. 2 papers, no midterm or final. Lectures are not mandatory and you can easily get an A without going. However, Professor Cook is great and gets you thinking about the themes and backgrounds of the books which can help in lecture and discussion. Definitely recommend.
